dedupe_keys.name: germany one kilometre daily historical and cmip5 climate series 1981 2100

description: This Zenodo dataset provides daily climate series for Germany from 1981 to 2100 on an underlying one-by-one-kilometre grid. It combines German Weather Service observations with EURO-CORDEX projections from three Earth system models and three CMIP5 concentration pathways, with bias correction to historical weather. The producer groups 355,944 grid cells into 10,000 spatial clusters for compact daily time series. The public release lists raster inputs and three very large ZIP archives of SQLite databases under CC BY 4.0. These are observed-derived historical and modelled future climate conditions, not a deterministic prediction of local weather. Cluster aggregation, bias-correction assumptions and CMIP5 scenario choice are limitations for street-scale drainage or building-load decisions. A reviewer-assessed use is driving long-term climate stress tests for German water and built-environment simulations. data-era5-reanalysis is a related historical forcing source, but no daily-variable equivalence was checked. No archive was downloaded.
